subject: Isolated S5 v5 client route stops beside northwest sandbags after a stationary forward hold
scope: One copied original-client 1.16.5.0 run using the ordinary copied Game DLL and post-Conrad-corpse character database. Only the copied mission 1995 objective 1 timer anchor was reset. No live or DIT change occurred.

exact_locations: output/driver-second-sandbag.log: final northwest checkpoint 1 through RuntimeError

comparison_source.exact_location: output/driver-second-sandbag.log northwest move 1.3 through move 2.1; output/positions.tsv corresponding accepted rows

observations.finding: The v5 client climbed the slope, reached the wreck approach, and advanced through northwest waypoint 1 at (-186.79688,95.015625,-29.53125). Its next accepted movement reached (-187.57812,95.16406,-30.242188) with about 311.9 seconds remaining. A further W hold at that position produced a fresh accepted packet with the same XYZ and a changed yaw from 0.8317052 to 1.535419, so the eight-second progress guard stopped at waypoint 2.1. The screenshot timer showed 05:01 after the guard wait.
observations.source_location: output/driver-second-sandbag.log final northwest lines; output/positions.tsv; output/nw-2-1-no-progress.png

observations.finding: The screenshot shows the player beside a low sandbag line, with rocky ground rising on the right. It supports local scenery interference as a possibility but does not prove a hard or universal collision from one stationary hold.

The earlier v3 copied-client passage approached the same corridor differently: from (-186.38281,94.79297,-29.046875) it accepted (-188.94531,94.71094,-29.703125) and then (-190.24219,94.72656,-30.042969). Compared with v5's stopped (-187.57812,95.16406,-30.242188), that trajectory remained roughly 0.5 m farther north in Z and lower in Y near the barrier. It is a candidate lateral approach, not proof that the offset alone caused passage.
observations.source_location: comparison_source output/driver-second-sandbag.log northwest move 1.3 through move 2.1; this run output/positions.tsv

observations.finding: Mission 1995 remained active, objective 1 active, objectives 2 and 3 complete. The copied SQLite database passed integrity check. No bomb approach or interaction occurred in this run.
The detached supervisor stopped at 299.73 seconds after driver exit 1; the copied launcher exited 0 and status.json recorded terminal client, Auth, Game, and display processes.

assessment.finding: The v4 0.25 m threshold failure was avoided, but v5 encountered a different local obstruction at the sandbags. Repeating the same fixed heading is unlikely to add useful evidence. A future bounded client test should follow the v3 accepted approach or use a guarded lateral adjustment while checking new Move packets, elevation and the timer.
